anndata.claude

anndata.claude is an R port of Python anndata for annotated data matrices.

Its first priority is full compatibility with the anndata on-disk formats (h5ad, and zarr later). An object read from a file is equal whichever language wrote it, and files written by R are structurally equivalent to files written by Python. The in-memory AnnData object supports that goal, with full feature parity as the long-term aim.

Relationship to Python anndata

Python anndata release 0.13.4 is the only reference for behaviour. This package matches its observable behaviour (values, errors, warnings and files written) but is idiomatic R rather than a line-by-line translation.

The package is developed with an autonomous loop and is at an early stage. Nothing is exported yet.

Acknowledgements

Thanks to the authors of Python anndata, whose design and file formats this package follows.
